title: Implement 60 bosses, profiles, illustrated Wiki, Windows/LAN and bounded recovery
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Implements sixty distinct boss identities and original themes across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons and six actual map footprints. Endless has seeded shuffle bags, twelve-clear repeat protection and guaranteed exclusive choices every fourth fight. The optional Uncounted banks campaign victory before individual entry choices; declining or losing keeps the campaign clear.

Adds local ProfileV1 with seven class mastery records (100 XP per completed encounter), teammate rescues, discovered codex entries, six authored ink insignia, personal/squad Endless bests, locale/settings and validated import/export with an exact previous-byte backup. Authority-recorded personal participation gates full-Hard unlocks for Insane/Hellish. Late joins plus the secret cannot replace missing campaign encounters. Repeated patches and older restored boundaries cannot duplicate mastery or remove memorials. Existing campaign-only records remain separate because participation is unknown. Profiles never supply combat power.

Keyboard/mouse actions and standard gamepad buttons are remappable with conflict/reserved-key checks; fire and interaction have independent Hold/Toggle choices. Touch/gamepad canonical actions remain independent of keyboard codes. HUD/tutorial hints use current mappings. Profile/control messages cover fifteen locales; newly surfaced boss histories are explicitly English pending translation. Protocol 13 serializes opaque run IDs and personal progress while concealing online seeds/future schedules. Bounded local protocol-4 through protocol-12 migrations preserve secret/Endless history; signed online state stays strict.

Boss work includes distinct counterplay, ordinary/Brutal phases, neutral solo-capable objectives, shared prediction geometry and exact projectile reflection updates. Production retains all original requests/native returns, 791 selected motion frames and sixty individual original themes; all fifty pre-Endless PCM masters remain unchanged. The in-game journal, repository changelog and seventeen-page illustrated native Wiki describe current implemented behavior.

Corrects the missing authored duration-to-health factor and friendly weapon damage against active Walking District buildings. Collision batching/spatial broad phases preserve same-tick destruction and exact rotated walls. Added a 210-combination progression matrix (168 timed, 42 Endless), 2,436 deliberate fixture clears, 2,226 restores and a 1,740-case actual-deployment health/deadline audit. These are progression/math checks, not human combat wins. Failed short throughput samples and CPU diagnostics remain preserved; zero-rendered-client localhost stress is separate from full capacity acceptance.

Validation: 290 rules/history/import/input/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL tests, authored-content/fifteen-locale checks, TypeScript and production build. Tests exercise all six difficulties online, personal participation, stale restores, failed writes, legacy records and canonical input routing. Exact source/build hashes are in reviews/runtime-verification.json. Browser control remains disabled in Work settings: no new rendered profile/sixty-boss acceptance is claimed. Earlier Raid screenshots remain evidence for their prior source.

Keep draft and protected main unchanged. Complete action/facing art, boss-history translation, final deadline/uptime balance, verified rankings, durable deployed recovery remain unfinished. The Windows development package is issued, with final manual/device/LAN acceptance open. Human listening, physical-device/native-language, WAN/endurance and final capacity acceptance remain open. The public Site still serves its older protocol-4 deployment.

Adds 61 audited compressed music copies with exact original WAV fallback. Decoded-duration validation rejects unsupported/padded compressed playback; all original PCM hashes remain unchanged. Objective FFmpeg fidelity/loop checks pass; browser/device and listening acceptance remains open.

Adds a sandboxed Electron 45 Windows app, restricted static protocol, native bell icon/metadata, runtime license collection and per-file build manifest. Offline startup creates no server. The explicit desktop LAN menu launches a bundled utility-process authority with validated ports/private IPv4 addresses and keeps the normal server rules. Packaged automated fixtures cover 210 offline starts, resume/movement/fire/profile/font, all 61 native compressed decodes, zero external requests, occupied-port preservation, two real WebSocket clients and graceful shutdown. All 1,633 package members match after fresh ZIP extraction and an ordinary Windows copy; all three copies passed their offline and LAN fixtures. Public release assets match exact anonymous-download hashes; this is an unsigned development build, with manual rendered/audio and physical second-machine LAN acceptance still open.

[Windows development download](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/releases/tag/dev-windows-20261024-1) is bound to source commit 52552c0d4465b918d7cde2ab3c2aa7f1d7eb045e. Its five assets include the 706.8 MiB ZIP, exact manifest, checksums, README and scoped verification JSON. Subsequent source changes do not alter that immutable artifact.

Adds context-bound authenticated checkpoint compression with a one-MiB decoded/46-KiB packed ceiling while keeping 64-KiB HTTP messages. A developed fifty-player/all-seven-class fixture retains 2,400 transaction replies through real HTTP, file-backed process replacement and competing-owner claim; all builds/progress/votes/RNG and successful/failed idempotency survive. Tests cover encoding changes, expansion bombs, malformed/trailing streams, legacy compatibility and maximum request/response headroom. Oversized/incompressible states latch unavailable without discarding replies. Normal runtime recovery stays disabled; worst-case paging, participant credentials, departed-player history and hosted rankings/recovery remain open. The issued Windows artifact stays bound to its earlier immutable source.

Adds the Tank's four-direction idle/attack/hurt/dash/downed library: twenty clips and 88 new drawn poses, with all 25 native returns/prompts retained. A pure presentation clock uses existing authoritative ammo, health, dodge and status fields; sustained fire, hit cancellation, late falls, final resting holds, revival and reduced motion have regression coverage. Independent pixel reconstruction validates shared strip scale, alpha padding and native/reference identity. Contact sheets and a tenth Wiki image document the poses; rendered Phaser/device/human acceptance remains open.
